description: Keylight's script writer for any narration or voiceover request ('add a voiceover', 'write narration', 'rewrite the script'), the same as Generate auto voiceover in the Voiceover panel: it watches the video and writes a script timed to the shots. Uses 1 script generation once approved (the reply says how many are left); the draft then appears in the Voiceover panel to read, edit, hear in any voice and record. For the person's own exact words, draft_narration is the tool. On a Full control connection it starts at once; otherwise it returns a confirmationId and waits for the owner's yes.

language.description: The script's language: en (English) or es (Spanish).

name: request_voiceover_script
title: Write the narration script
